Hi Tom / Priya — quick technical note ahead of the call to make the failure-mode conversation concrete.

Short version (for runbook insertion):
- Control-plane unreachable (30s–3m): data-plane inference requests continue for cached sessions / pinned models until KV cache TTL expires. No new session pinning or model switches. Telemetry: increased 5xx proxy errors; runtime will queue short-lived in-memory pending requests for up to 45s then fail with a 503.
- Control-plane outage (3m–30m): best-effort degraded mode where model switching and cert rotations are disabled; existing sessions limited by GPU memory and KV cache; we recommend circuit-breaker on client side at 60s.
- Extended outage (>30m): recommend operator-led failover to Redwood Dedicated (if you have a contractual fallback) or follow our manual restart and certificate re-issue steps in the attached runbook.

For the call I'll share a 1-slide failure-mode flow that maps these timings to observable logs / metrics (http 5xx, runtime queue depth, KV miss rates). If ACME has a watchdog window you want us to respect for automated restarts, please share the SLA/watchdog policy.

Attachment: failure-mode-slide (embedded in runbook PDF)

—Aditya
